name: Finding & reporting problems
desc: Triage and document defects: turn failed test runs into filed, linked bug tickets, re-verify fixes in a live browser before release, and generate the repro test straight from a bug report.

name: Deciding what to test
desc: Turn requirements into a test plan: aggregate feature context, generate and review test cases, sharpen vague acceptance criteria against the designs, and schedule execution across the team.

name: Keeping the project tracker up to date
desc: Keep Azure DevOps in sync via the REST API — create, link, and update work items and test cases, import from spreadsheets, post results, and push rollups — with no manual board-keeping.

name: Checking the screens look right
desc: Verify the UI across viewports: drive the app on emulated devices with Playwright, diff live screens against the design source, and capture repro steps when a breakpoint fails.

name: Grading the AI assistant's answers
desc: Evaluate LLM output: score answers against a rubric, benchmark competing models on the same prompts, and check the assistant obeys its own system prompt — LLM-as-judge, with evidence.

name: Investigating the app's data & behavior
desc: Inspect data and behavior directly: translate questions to SQL, drive the app's API, trace agent-mode steps, and verify citations and latency claims against ground truth.

name: Turning results into reports people read
desc: Turn raw results into shareable artifacts: aggregate scattered quality scores and UAT feedback into self-contained HTML dashboards and stakeholder-ready reports.

name: The reusable toolkit — works on any project
desc: Four jobs recurred on every project, so they're extracted into typed, dependency-checked modules that drop into any repo — ADO client, HTML report builder, API tester, DB verifier — with or without Azure.
